calls.title: TRR & Growthbook
calls.summary: The organization is considering purchasing a tool with a pro license, pending formal approval expected by the end of May. Key points include the design team's urgency for adoption to support new initiatives, the need for documented use cases, and the budget constraints of a not-for-profit status favoring the pro tier over higher options. There are concerns regarding tier limitations that may restrict testing capabilities to four experiments per month. Active communication between stakeholders is emphasized, with a commitment to maintain updates until a formal decision is reached. The internal approval process has been slow but is nearing completion, with hopes to finalize contracts soon.
calls.keywords: Tool purchase, subscription tiers, Pro license, Request for Information, organizational decision, design department initiatives
calls.action_items:
